```{r}
# ============================================================
# V2: FULL EUNOMIA GIBLEED POPULATION
# ============================================================

person <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/GiBleed/PERSON.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename_with(tolower)

drug_exposure <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/GiBleed/DRUG_EXPOSURE.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename_with(tolower)

condition_occurrence <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/GiBleed/CONDITION_OCCURRENCE.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename_with(tolower)

observation_period <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/GiBleed/OBSERVATION_PERIOD.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename_with(tolower)

measurement <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/GiBleed/MEASUREMENT.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename_with(tolower)

concept <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/GiBleed/CONCEPT.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename_with(tolower)

concept_ancestor <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/GiBleed/CONCEPT_ANCESTOR.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename_with(tolower)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================

condition_concepts <- condition_occurrence %>%
  count(condition_concept_id, name = "patients") %>%
  left_join(
    concept %>%
      select(
        concept_id,
        concept_name,
        domain_id,
        vocabulary_id,
        concept_class_id,
        standard_concept
      ),
    by = c("condition_concept_id" = "concept_id")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(patients))

print(condition_concepts, n = 50)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# GI BLEEDING PREVALENCE
# ============================================================

total_patients <- n_distinct(person$person_id)

gi_bleed_patients <- n_distinct(
  gi_bleed_events$person_id
)

gi_bleed_prevalence <- gi_bleed_patients / total_patients

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("GI BLEEDING PREVALENCE\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

cat("Total patients:", total_patients, "\n")
cat("GI bleeding patients:", gi_bleed_patients, "\n")
cat(
  "No GI bleeding patients:",
  total_patients - gi_bleed_patients,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "GI bleeding prevalence:",
  round(gi_bleed_prevalence, 4),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "GI bleeding prevalence (%):",
  round(gi_bleed_prevalence * 100, 2),
  "%\n"
)
```

```{r}
cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("V2 OBSERVATION PERIOD ANALYSIS\n")

observation_summary <- observation_period %>%
  summarise(
    patients = n_distinct(person_id),
    observation_records = n(),
    earliest_start = min(observation_period_start_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    latest_start = max(observation_period_start_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    earliest_end = min(observation_period_end_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    latest_end = max(observation_period_end_date, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(observation_summary)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# OBSERVATION PERIOD LENGTH
# ============================================================

observation_lengths <- observation_period %>%
  mutate(
    observation_days =
      as.numeric(
        observation_period_end_date -
        observation_period_start_date
      ),
    observation_years = observation_days / 365.25
  )

summary(observation_lengths$observation_days)

cat("\nObservation period years:\n")
summary(observation_lengths$observation_years)

# ============================================================
# CHECK GI BLEEDING DATES
# ============================================================

gi_bleed_dates <- gi_bleed_events %>%
  summarise(
    earliest_gi_bleed = min(condition_start_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    latest_gi_bleed = max(condition_start_date, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(gi_bleed_dates)

# ============================================================
# GI BLEEDING EVENTS WITH OBSERVATION PERIOD
# ============================================================

gi_bleed_timing <- gi_bleed_events %>%
  select(
    person_id,
    condition_start_date
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    observation_period %>%
      select(
        person_id,
        observation_period_start_date,
        observation_period_end_date
      ),
    by = "person_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    within_observation_period =
      condition_start_date >= observation_period_start_date &
      condition_start_date <= observation_period_end_date
  )

cat(
  "\nGI bleeding records within observation period:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    gi_bleed_timing$within_observation_period,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# CREATE FULL PATIENT-LEVEL OUTCOME
# ============================================================

gi_bleed_patient_ids <- condition_occurrence %>%
  filter(
    condition_concept_id == 192671
  ) %>%
  distinct(person_id) %>%
  mutate(outcome = 1)

v2_population <- person %>%
  select(person_id) %>%
  left_join(
    gi_bleed_patient_ids,
    by = "person_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = ifelse(
      is.na(outcome),
      0,
      outcome
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# VALIDATE OUTCOME
# ============================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("V2 PATIENT-LEVEL OUTCOME\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

cat(
  "Total patients:",
  nrow(v2_population),
  "\n"
)

cat("\nOutcome distribution:\n")
print(table(v2_population$outcome))

cat("\nOutcome proportions:\n")
print(prop.table(table(v2_population$outcome)))

cat(
  "\nGI bleeding patients:",
  sum(v2_population$outcome == 1),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "No GI bleeding patients:",
  sum(v2_population$outcome == 0),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# V2: CALCULATE AGE AT DATASET END
# ============================================================

v2_reference_date <- as.Date("2019-07-01")

v2_demographics <- person %>%
  select(
    person_id,
    gender_concept_id,
    year_of_birth,
    race_concept_id
  ) %>%
  mutate(

    # Sex
    sex = case_when(
      gender_concept_id == 8532 ~ "MALE",
      gender_concept_id == 8507 ~ "FEMALE",
      TRUE ~ "UNKNOWN"
    ),

    # Race
    race = case_when(
      race_concept_id == 8527 ~ "White",
      race_concept_id == 8516 ~ "Black or African American",
      race_concept_id == 8515 ~ "Asian",
      race_concept_id == 0    ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),

    # Age at end of available dataset
    age = as.numeric(
      format(v2_reference_date, "%Y")
    ) - year_of_birth
  ) %>%
  select(
    person_id,
    sex,
    age,
    race
  )

# ============================================================
# VALIDATION
# ============================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("V2 DEMOGRAPHIC FEATURES\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

cat(
  "Reference date:",
  format(v2_reference_date, "%Y-%m-%d"),
  "\n"
)
cat("Rows:", nrow(v2_demographics), "\n")
cat("Unique patients:", n_distinct(v2_demographics$person_id), "\n\n")

cat("Sex distribution:\n")
print(table(v2_demographics$sex))

cat("\nRace distribution:\n")
print(table(v2_demographics$race))

cat("\nAge summary:\n")
print(summary(v2_demographics$age))

cat("\nMissing values:\n")
print(colSums(is.na(v2_demographics)))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# V2: MEDICATION FEATURES
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Medication lookup
# ------------------------------------------------------------

drug_lookup <- tibble::tribble(
  ~feature_name,       ~concept_id, ~description,
  "prior_aspirin",      19059056,   "Prior Aspirin Use",
  "prior_naproxen",     1115171,    "Prior Naproxen Use",
  "prior_celecoxib",    1118084,    "Prior Celecoxib Use"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Extract relevant drug exposures
# ------------------------------------------------------------

v2_drug_exposures <- drug_exposure %>%
  filter(
    drug_concept_id %in% drug_lookup$concept_id,
    drug_exposure_start_date <= v2_reference_date
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    drug_lookup,
    by = c("drug_concept_id" = "concept_id")
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    person_id,
    feature_name
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Convert to patient-level binary variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

v2_medications_wide <- v2_drug_exposures %>%
  mutate(value = 1L) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = feature_name,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = 0L
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Start with ALL 2,694 patients
# ------------------------------------------------------------

v2_medications <- person %>%
  select(person_id) %>%
  left_join(
    v2_medications_wide,
    by = "person_id"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Guarantee that every medication variable exists
# ------------------------------------------------------------

medication_features <- c(
  "prior_aspirin",
  "prior_naproxen",
  "prior_celecoxib"
)

for (feature in medication_features) {

  if (!feature %in% names(v2_medications)) {
    v2_medications[[feature]] <- 0L
  }

}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Replace missing values with zero
# ------------------------------------------------------------

v2_medications <- v2_medications %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(medication_features),
      ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0L)
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 7. VALIDATION
# ============================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("V2 MEDICATION FEATURES\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

cat(
  "Rows:",
  nrow(v2_medications),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Unique patients:",
  dplyr::n_distinct(v2_medications$person_id),
  "\n"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Medication counts
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nMedication exposure counts:\n")

medication_counts <- v2_medications %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(medication_features),
      ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

print(medication_counts)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Medication proportions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nMedication exposure proportions:\n")

medication_proportions <- v2_medications %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(medication_features),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

print(medication_proportions)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Missing values
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nMissing values:\n")

print(
  colSums(
    is.na(v2_medications)
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Structure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nStructure:\n")

str(v2_medications)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# V2: MEASUREMENT FEATURE EXPLORATION
# ============================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("V2 MEASUREMENT FEATURES\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Number of measurement records
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "Total measurement records:",
  nrow(measurement),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Unique patients with measurements:",
  n_distinct(measurement$person_id),
  "\n"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Most common measurement concepts
# ------------------------------------------------------------

measurement_summary <- measurement %>%
  count(
    measurement_concept_id,
    sort = TRUE
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    concept %>%
      select(
        concept_id,
        concept_name
      ),
    by = c(
      "measurement_concept_id" = "concept_id"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    measurement_concept_id,
    concept_name,
    n
  )

cat("\nTop measurement concepts:\n\n")

print(
  measurement_summary %>%
    slice_head(n = 30)
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Patient coverage
# ------------------------------------------------------------

measurement_patient_coverage <- measurement %>%
  group_by(
    measurement_concept_id
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    patients = n_distinct(person_id),
    records = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    concept %>%
      select(
        concept_id,
        concept_name
      ),
    by = c(
      "measurement_concept_id" = "concept_id"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(patients)
  )

cat("\nMeasurement patient coverage:\n\n")

print(
  measurement_patient_coverage %>%
    slice_head(n = 30)
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# V2: CLINICAL CONDITION FEATURE EXPLORATION
# ============================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("V2 CLINICAL CONDITION FEATURES\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Top condition concepts
# ------------------------------------------------------------

condition_summary <- condition_occurrence %>%
  count(
    condition_concept_id,
    sort = TRUE
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    concept %>%
      select(
        concept_id,
        concept_name
      ),
    by = c(
      "condition_concept_id" = "concept_id"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    condition_concept_id,
    concept_name,
    n
  )


cat("Top 50 condition concepts:\n\n")

print(
  condition_summary %>%
    slice_head(n = 50)
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Search for clinically relevant GI conditions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gi_condition_candidates <- condition_summary %>%
  filter(
    grepl(
      paste(
        c(
          "ulcer",
          "gastro",
          "intestinal",
          "esoph",
          "colitis",
          "divert",
          "gastric",
          "duoden",
          "hemorr",
          "bleed"
        ),
        collapse = "|"
      ),
      concept_name,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  )


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("POTENTIAL GI-RELATED CONDITIONS\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

print(
  gi_condition_candidates
)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# V2: CLINICAL CONDITION FEATURES
# ============================================================

condition_lookup <- tibble::tribble(
  ~feature_name,              ~concept_id, ~description,
  "prior_peptic_ulcer",        4027663,   "Prior Peptic Ulcer",
  "prior_ulcerative_colitis",    81893,   "Prior Ulcerative Colitis",
  "prior_esophagitis",           30753,   "Prior Esophagitis",
  "prior_diverticular_disease", 4266809,  "Prior Diverticular Disease"
)


# ============================================================
# EXTRACT RELEVANT CONDITIONS
# ============================================================

v2_condition_features <- condition_occurrence %>%
  filter(
    condition_concept_id %in% condition_lookup$concept_id
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    condition_lookup,
    by = c(
      "condition_concept_id" = "concept_id"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    person_id,
    feature_name
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    value = 1L
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = feature_name,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = 0L
  )


# ============================================================
# RETAIN ALL 2,694 PATIENTS
# ============================================================

v2_conditions <- person %>%
  select(person_id) %>%
  left_join(
    v2_condition_features,
    by = "person_id"
  )


# ============================================================
# GUARANTEE ALL FOUR FEATURES EXIST
# ============================================================

condition_features <- c(
  "prior_peptic_ulcer",
  "prior_ulcerative_colitis",
  "prior_esophagitis",
  "prior_diverticular_disease"
)

for (feature in condition_features) {

  if (!feature %in% names(v2_conditions)) {
    v2_conditions[[feature]] <- 0L
  }

}


# ============================================================
# REPLACE MISSING VALUES WITH ZERO
# ============================================================

v2_conditions <- v2_conditions %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(condition_features),
      ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0L)
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# VALIDATION
# ============================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("V2 CLINICAL CONDITION FEATURES\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

cat(
  "Rows:",
  nrow(v2_conditions),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Unique patients:",
  dplyr::n_distinct(v2_conditions$person_id),
  "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# CONDITION COUNTS
# ============================================================

cat("\nCondition counts:\n")

condition_counts <- v2_conditions %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(condition_features),
      ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

print(condition_counts)


# ============================================================
# CONDITION PROPORTIONS
# ============================================================

cat("\nCondition proportions:\n")

condition_proportions <- v2_conditions %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(condition_features),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

print(condition_proportions)


# ============================================================
# MISSING VALUES
# ============================================================

cat("\nMissing values:\n")

print(
  colSums(
    is.na(v2_conditions)
  )
)


# ============================================================
# STRUCTURE
# ============================================================

cat("\nStructure:\n")

str(v2_conditions)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# CUSTOM CV SUMMARY FUNCTION
# ============================================================

pr_auc_summary <- function(data, lev = NULL, model = NULL) {

  # Positive class = Yes
  actual <- ifelse(
    data$obs == "Yes",
    1,
    0
  )

  probability <- data$Yes

  # AUROC
  roc_value <- tryCatch(
    {
      as.numeric(
        pROC::auc(
          pROC::roc(
            actual,
            probability,
            quiet = TRUE,
            direction = "<"
          )
        )
      )
    },
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  # AUPRC
  pr_value <- tryCatch(
    {
      PRROC::pr.curve(
        scores.class0 = probability[actual == 1],
        scores.class1 = probability[actual == 0],
        curve = FALSE
      )$auc.integral
    },
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  c(
    AUROC = roc_value,
    AUPRC = pr_value
  )
}
```

```{r}
  1,
  0

cat("\n========================================\n")
```

```{r}
xgb_grid <- expand.grid(
  nrounds = c(100, 200),
  max_depth = c(2, 3),
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# XGBOOST 5-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION
# PRIMARY METRIC = AUPRC
# ============================================================

xgb_results <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(xgb_grid))) {

  params <- xgb_grid[i, ]

  cat(
    "\n----------------------------------------\n"
  )

  cat(
    "XGBoost combination",
    i,
    "of",
    nrow(xgb_grid),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "nrounds =", params$nrounds,
    "| max_depth =", params$max_depth,
    "| eta =", params$eta,
    "\n"
  )

  fold_auprc <- numeric(length(xgb_folds))
  fold_auroc <- numeric(length(xgb_folds))

  for (fold in seq_along(xgb_folds)) {

    test_idx <- xgb_folds[[fold]]

    train_idx <- setdiff(
      seq_len(nrow(xgb_x)),
      test_idx
    )

    dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(
      data = xgb_x[train_idx, , drop = FALSE],
      label = xgb_y[train_idx]
    )

    dvalid <- xgb.DMatrix(
      data = xgb_x[test_idx, , drop = FALSE],
      label = xgb_y[test_idx]
    )

    xgb_params <- list(
      objective = "binary:logistic",
      eval_metric = "logloss",
      max_depth = params$max_depth,
      eta = params$eta,
      gamma = params$gamma,
      colsample_bytree = params$colsample_bytree,
      min_child_weight = params$min_child_weight,
      subsample = params$subsample,
      nthread = 1
    )

    set.seed(
      2026 + i + fold
    )

    xgb_fit <- xgb.train(
      params = xgb_params,
      data = dtrain,
      nrounds = params$nrounds,
      verbose = 0
    )

    predictions <- predict(
      xgb_fit,
      dvalid
    )

    actual <- xgb_y[test_idx]

    # ----------------------------------------
    # AUPRC
    # ----------------------------------------

    pr_result <- PRROC::pr.curve(
      scores.class0 = predictions[actual == 1],
      scores.class1 = predictions[actual == 0],
      curve = FALSE
    )

    fold_auprc[fold] <- pr_result$auc.integral

    # ----------------------------------------
    # AUROC
    # ----------------------------------------

    roc_result <- pROC::roc(
      actual,
      predictions,
      quiet = TRUE
    )

    fold_auroc[fold] <- as.numeric(
      pROC::auc(roc_result)
    )

  }

  xgb_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    nrounds = params$nrounds,
    max_depth = params$max_depth,
    eta = params$eta,
    gamma = params$gamma,
    colsample_bytree = params$colsample_bytree,
    min_child_weight = params$min_child_weight,
    subsample = params$subsample,

    Mean_AUPRC = mean(
      fold_auprc
    ),

    SD_AUPRC = sd(
      fold_auprc
    ),

    Mean_AUROC = mean(
      fold_auroc
    ),

    SD_AUROC = sd(
      fold_auroc
    )
  )

  cat(
    "Mean AUPRC:",
    round(mean(fold_auprc), 4),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Mean AUROC:",
    round(mean(fold_auroc), 4),
    "\n"
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# V2: FINAL CROSS-VALIDATION MODEL COMPARISON
# PERFORMANCE AT SELECTED TUNING PARAMETERS
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper function
# Extract CV performance corresponding to bestTune
# ------------------------------------------------------------

get_best_cv <- function(model, model_name) {

  best <- model$bestTune

  res <- model$results

  # Match the best tuning parameters
  for (col in names(best)) {
    res <- res[
      res[[col]] == best[[col]],
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }

  data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    Mean_AUROC = res$AUROC[1],
    SD_AUROC = res$AUROCSD[1],
    Mean_AUPRC = res$AUPRC[1],
    SD_AUPRC = res$AUPRCSD[1]
  )
}


# ============================================================
# EXTRACT SELECTED MODEL PERFORMANCE
# ============================================================

logistic_cv <- get_best_cv(
  logistic_v2,
  "Logistic Regression"
)

elastic_cv <- get_best_cv(
  elastic_net_v2,
  "Elastic Net"
)

rf_cv <- get_best_cv(
  random_forest_v2,
  "Random Forest"
)

gbm_cv <- get_best_cv(
  gbm_v2,
  "GBM"
)

svm_cv <- get_best_cv(
  svm_v2,
  "SVM"
)


# ============================================================
# XGBOOST
# ============================================================

xgb_cv <- data.frame(
  Model = "XGBoost",
  Mean_AUROC = xgb_cv_results$Mean_AUROC[1],
  SD_AUROC = xgb_cv_results$SD_AUROC[1],
  Mean_AUPRC = xgb_cv_results$Mean_AUPRC[1],
  SD_AUPRC = xgb_cv_results$SD_AUPRC[1]
)


# ============================================================
# COMBINE ALL SIX MODELS
# ============================================================

final_cv_comparison <- bind_rows(
  logistic_cv,
  elastic_cv,
  rf_cv,
  gbm_cv,
  svm_cv,
  xgb_cv
) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(Mean_AUPRC)
  )


# ============================================================
# DISPLAY FINAL CV RESULTS
# ============================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("V2 FINAL 5-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION RESULTS\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

print(
  final_cv_comparison,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# V2 FINAL XGBOOST MODEL
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare training matrix
# ------------------------------------------------------------

xgb_formula <- ~
  sex +
  age +
  race +
  prior_aspirin +
  prior_naproxen +
  prior_celecoxib +
  prior_peptic_ulcer +
  prior_ulcerative_colitis +
  prior_esophagitis +
  prior_diverticular_disease

x_train <- model.matrix(
  xgb_formula,
  data = train_model
)

x_train <- x_train[
  ,
  colnames(x_train) != "(Intercept)",
  drop = FALSE
]

y_train <- ifelse(
  train_model$outcome == "Yes",
  1,
  0
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Prepare untouched test matrix
# ------------------------------------------------------------

x_test <- model.matrix(
  xgb_formula,
  data = test_model
)

x_test <- x_test[
  ,
  colnames(x_test) != "(Intercept)",
  drop = FALSE
]

y_test <- ifelse(
  test_model$outcome == "Yes",
  1,
  0
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Ensure identical predictor columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

x_test <- x_test[
  ,
  colnames(x_train),
  drop = FALSE
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create XGBoost matrices
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dtrain_final <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = x_train,
  label = y_train
)

dtest_final <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = x_test,
  label = y_test
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Final model parameters
# ------------------------------------------------------------

final_xgb_params <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "logloss",

  max_depth = 2,
  eta = 0.03,
  gamma = 0,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  min_child_weight = 1,
  subsample = 0.8,

  nthread = 1
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Fit final model
# ------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(2026)

final_xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params = final_xgb_params,
  data = dtrain_final,
  nrounds = 200,
  verbose = 0
)

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("V2 FINAL XGBOOST MODEL\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

cat("Training patients:", nrow(train_model), "\n")
cat("Test patients:", nrow(test_model), "\n")
cat("Boosting rounds: 200\n")
cat("Maximum tree depth: 2\n")
cat("Learning rate: 0.03\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================

TN <- confusion_matrix["No", "No"]
FP <- confusion_matrix["Yes", "No"]
FN <- confusion_matrix["No", "Yes"]
TP <- confusion_matrix["Yes", "Yes"]

sensitivity <- TP / (TP + FN)

specificity <- TN / (TN + FP)

ppv <- TP / (TP + FP)

npv <- TN / (TN + FN)

accuracy <- (
  TP + TN
) / sum(confusion_matrix)

f1 <- (
  2 * TP
) / (
  2 * TP + FP + FN
)

final_metrics <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "AUROC",
    "AUPRC",
    "Sensitivity",
    "Specificity",
    "PPV",
    "NPV",
    "F1",
    "Accuracy"
  ),

  Value = c(
    final_auroc,
    final_auprc,
    sensitivity,
    specificity,
    ppv,
    npv,
    f1,
    accuracy
  )
)

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("V2 FINAL TEST-SET PERFORMANCE\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

print(
  final_metrics %>%
    mutate(
      Value = round(Value, 4)
    ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# FINAL CLASSIFICATION METRICS
# ============================================================

TN <- confusion_matrix["No", "No"]
FP <- confusion_matrix["Yes", "No"]
FN <- confusion_matrix["No", "Yes"]
TP <- confusion_matrix["Yes", "Yes"]

sensitivity <- TP / (TP + FN)

specificity <- TN / (TN + FP)

ppv <- ifelse(
  TP + FP > 0,
  TP / (TP + FP),
  NA
)

npv <- TN / (TN + FN)

f1 <- ifelse(
  2 * TP + FP + FN > 0,
  2 * TP / (2 * TP + FP + FN),
  NA
)

accuracy <- (TP + TN) / (
  TP + TN + FP + FN
)

final_classification <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Threshold",
    "Sensitivity",
    "Specificity",
    "PPV",
    "NPV",
    "F1",
    "Accuracy"
  ),
  Value = c(
    final_threshold,
    sensitivity,
    specificity,
    ppv,
    npv,
    f1,
    accuracy
  )
)

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("V2 FINAL TEST-SET CLASSIFICATION\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

print(
  final_classification %>%
    mutate(
      Value = round(Value, 4)
    ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
  prior_celecoxib = 1,

  prior_peptic_ulcer = 1,
  prior_ulcerative_colitis = 1,
  prior_esophagitis = 1,
  prior_diverticular_disease = 1
)

# ============================================================
# CONVERT PATIENT TO XGBOOST INPUT FORMAT
# ============================================================

sample_matrix <- model.matrix(
  xgb_formula,
  data = sample_patient
)

sample_matrix <- sample_matrix[
  ,
  colnames(sample_matrix) != "(Intercept)",
  drop = FALSE
]


# Ensure exactly the same columns as training data
sample_matrix <- sample_matrix[
  ,
  colnames(x_train),
  drop = FALSE
]


# Create XGBoost matrix
sample_dmatrix <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = sample_matrix
)


# ============================================================
# PREDICT GI BLEEDING RISK
# ============================================================

sample_probability <- predict(
  final_xgb_model,
  sample_dmatrix
)

  sample_probability >= 0.205,
  "HIGH RISK",
  "LOW RISK"
)

)

)
```
